_doc: Declared changes applied by scripts/extract.ts to the runtime ('runtime') or page content ('content'), and by the parity test to the original file, so both sides compare like for like: wording and export changes (decisions Q3, Q4) and accessibility fixes (Phase 5). 'count' is the number of matches expected in source/atlas.html.

patches.why: Q3: the downloaded interactive diagram loaded Inter from Google Fonts. Exports now use the stylesheet's system-font fallbacks.
Q4: shown on LLM as a judge when AI is off.
patches.find: Open the Atlas on claude.ai to run this judge with Claude. You can still copy the prompt and run it in your own pipeline.
patches.replace: AI features are turned off on this site. You can still copy the prompt and run it in your own pipeline.

patches.why: Q4: shown on the page builder when AI is off.
patches.find: Drafting needs Claude, which is available when the Atlas is open on claude.ai.
patches.replace: AI drafting is turned off on this site.

patches.why: Q4: download fallback (only shown if a browser can't save files).
patches.find: Open the Atlas on claude.ai to export files.

patches.why: Q4: download fallbacks (only shown if a browser can't save files).
patches.find: Open the Atlas on claude.ai to export.

patches.why: Q4: voice-over now uses the browser's own voices.
patches.find: title="Narrate each step in a Claude voice"

patches.why: Q4: shown on /team/ (unlisted) since Team mode is off.
patches.find: Team mode needs the Atlas open on claude.ai while signed in. Your own progress still works on every page.
patches.replace: Team mode isn\'t available on this site. Your own progress still works on every page.

patches.why: Q4: Ask the Atlas footer (visible only when AI is on). Requests go through this site's proxy, not the visitor's own account.
patches.find: Answers come from Claude on your own account, grounded in the page you
patches.replace: Answers come from Claude through this site, grounded in the page you

patches.why: Phase 5: the diagram SVG contains focusable boxes, so it is a labelled group rather than an image (axe nested-interactive).
Phase 5: same for the sequence view.
Phase 5: a diagram box's accessible name now includes its visible subtitle (axe label-content-name-mismatch).
Phase 5: the small ✓ + ↑ badge on a diagram box is decorative; hide it from assistive technology so the box's name matches its visible text.
Phase 5: the AI landscape rings are focusable buttons, so their SVG is a labelled group, not an image.
Phase 5: a space between a diagram box's title and subtitle (they sit on separate lines), so its visible text reads as two words and matches its accessible name.
Phase 5: same for classic-theme diagram boxes.
Phase 5: maturity pyramid bars encode the score in their tint; white text on light tints failed contrast. The label now sits on a solid chip (class lbl-chip).
Phase 5: landscape rings show an abbreviation (AI, ML, DL…) but were named only by the full term; the name now starts with what is shown.
Phase 5: glossary tooltips mark each term once per page; they must skip the text versions the site adds under diagrams (.atlas-a11y), or they mark the term there instead of in the page body.
